steps.label: SingleBrain on the Bryois gene set
Bryois pseudobulk vs cell types (D-007)
steps.detail: change in constrained-gene gap on going from pseudobulk to 8 cell types, same donors: +0.005 [-0.035, +0.048]. Interval spans zero but is bounded at 0.048, 22% of the ladder closure: an informative null.

steps.label: within-SingleBrain resolution test
steps.detail: change in constrained-gene gap on splitting a class into its subtypes, pooled across 6 classes: -0.007 [-0.021, +0.005]. Every one of the 6 per-class intervals spans zero, so the per-class signs are noise and only the pooled estimate is quoted. Donors, pipeline and normalisation are identical between arms.
